Yes! You're eligible for the price-drop credit. Since you purchased within the last 7 days and the plant has dropped in price, you'll receive **$8 as store credit** (the difference). This applies once per item and excludes flash sales and clearance items.

The credit will be issued instantly to your Leafy account—no expiration date. You can use it on your next order. Just confirm the plant isn't from a flash sale or clearance section, and I can process this for you (or you can contact support with your order number).
